## Welcome

This project provides an interactive charting dashboard for analyzing historical stock price data from 10 major NASDAQ companies.

### Featured Stocks

- **AAPL** - Apple Inc.
- **GOOGL** - Alphabet Inc.
- **MSFT** - Microsoft Corporation
- **AMZN** - Amazon.com Inc.
- **TSLA** - Tesla Inc.
- **NVDA** - NVIDIA Corporation
- **META** - Meta Platforms Inc.
- **NFLX** - Netflix Inc.
- **ADBE** - Adobe Inc.
- **INTC** - Intel Corporation

### Features

- 📊 **Interactive Charts** - Candlestick, OHLC, and Line chart types
- 📅 **Time Filtering** - View 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, or all-time data
- 📈 **Real-time Statistics** - Open, High, Low, Volume, and 52-week metrics
- 🔄 **Dynamic Stock Selection** - Switch between stocks seamlessly

### Data Source

All historical data is sourced directly from [NASDAQ.com](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/quotes/historical), covering approximately 2 years of trading data (~499 trading days per stock).
